content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm encountering a minor issue with my [product_name]. I have a counter that users can adjust using the F2 key. Occasionally, when pressing it once, the count increases by two instead of one. I'm programming this in ladder logic. Any suggestions on how to fix this?
You should add an on-delay of around 0.3 seconds between the F key and the counter input to debounce the key press. I experienced a similar issue with my [product_name] operator panel.

Another user confirms having faced the same problem and recommends implementing a debounce delay to prevent multiple counts from a single button press.
